market.question: Will the lowest temperature in Miami be between 74-75°F on April 29?

assessment.reasoning: AccuWeather forecast for Miami April 29 shows low around 73°F. Question asks if the daily low falls in the 74-75°F bucket. With forecast slightly below this band and typical ±2°F forecast error 2 days out, probability is in the lower-middle range of bucket distribution. Likely buckets are 72-73 or 73-74.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecast may shift; precise station reading at KMIA could land just inside or outside 74-75 range.
